messages.subject: Loading multible transects into DSsim
parts:
Hi folks, 

I'm trying to run a series of simulations in a region of my own design. 

I have generated shapefiles for the transect legs (12) in Distance (for windows using GIS Arcview) but I can't seem to get the DSsim to run past the first transect. 

subjective.design <- make.design(transect.type = "Line", 
                                 design.details = c("user specified"), 
                                 region = region, 
                                 plus.sampling = FALSE, 
                                 path = "Survey Transects/My Design")

I have specefied the path as the folder in which the 12 transect shapefiles ( and associated files) are located. 

my.simulation.subjective <- make.simulation(reps = 10, 
                                            single.transect.set = TRUE, 
                                            region.obj = region, 
                                            design.obj = subjective.design, 
                                            population.description.obj = pop.description,
                                            detectability.obj = detect, 
                                            ddf.analyses.list = ddf.analyses)


I have specified a single set of line transects 

Any help appriciated. 

Thanks 

Emmett

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: {Disarmed} Re: [distance-sampling] Loading multible transects into DSsim
parts:
Emmett

Happy to see you are using the simulation capability of Distance.

Have a look at the "Simulation Example" project that ships with the Distance sample projects.  If you look inside the folder

C:\Users\erexs\Documents\My Distance Projects\Sample Projects\Simulation Example.dat

you will find some shape files, specifically Parallel and Zigzag.  They are used in the simulation example.

If you open the Parallel.shp file in Qgis, you will see that it is composed of multiple transects (see below)


The lesson for you is that you want a single shape file that contains all 12 of your transects.  Distance thinks your entire survey resides within that first shapefile you specified.

See if that works for you.
